M.name: Maryborough (Churchill Street) / Maryborough (Portside)
M.src: BoM gauge 540637 (Mary River at Maryborough (Churchill Street)): 13 highs/13 lows over 7 days matched to Kingfisher Bay jetty predictions; HW lag sd 19 min, LW lag sd 19 min; gauge datum unknown so heights are interpolated; low heights do not track the port (flat/damped lows) so low heights come from neighbours, low timing from this gauge || BoM gauge 040443 (Mary River at Maryborough (Portside)): 13 highs/12 lows over 7 days matched to Kingfisher Bay jetty predictions; HW lag sd 11 min, LW lag sd 50 min; gauge datum unknown so heights are interpolated; lows are flat at this gauge (sensor or channel dries) so low-water timing/height come from neighbouring calibration

M.name: Weir / barrage
M.src: Generic extrapolation 23.2 km beyond the last calibration: median lag growth of all calibrated QLD places/gauges in this region (HW +1.2, LW +1.9 min/km, halved for a deep weir pool); heights held at the last calibrated values
